why: Title and pay fit and the stack matches (agents, RAG, FastAPI, Azure), but the JD asks 5+ years and the resume shows 2.
company_size_basis: Well-known: WSP is a global engineering firm with tens of thousands of staff. JD text says 'global community' and 'one of the world's leading engineering firms'; no head count on page.

customisation.change: Lead the summary with 'production agentic AI, RAG and LLM systems on Azure' and 'FastAPI backend'.
Put retrieval work first: Azure AI Search / Vertex AI RAG agents and pgvector search.
Show evaluation strategy: LLM judge, golden set, benchmark of LLM candidates.
Show CI/CD and multi-environment deploys with GitHub Actions, Terraform, ArgoCD.
Add entity extraction / entity resolution experience.

interview_questions: Describe an agent system you took to production and how you scaled it (Slideoo 10x traffic, F010).
How did you improve retrieval quality and test it (F009, F018, F021)?
How would you handle entity resolution across structured and unstructured data? (gap; no fact)
